معدات:
Fuel Gas Strainer
 1.53.1.270.500NW150
 Siemens - Germany

توضح هذه الوثيقة قائمة فحص المعدات I1، التي يجب إجراؤها 
عندما يكون Δ P = 0.6 بار كما هو موضح في الكتلة التي تحمل عنوانًا أعلاه

The first draft is initiated by eng. Saad Samra, tested by eng. Mohamed Abdel 
Azeem at 01 July 2003, accepted by by general manager eng. Mohamed El-Sarrag, 
revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Abouda El-Bana, and approved by eng. 
Moneer Mahmoud El-Wakeel Damietta CCPS Head Sector.

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance stuff should be 
 carry the 
 suitable safety category,

Use Safety fences with caution marks to surround the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the filter mechanically by closing inlet & outlet valves.
قم بإلغاء تهوية الفلتر عن طريق فتح صمام إزالة الهواء قبل فتحه.
Drain the filter by opening the drain valve.

sections.text:
نصيحة 
 سلة الشاشة وتنظيفها بالهواء المضغوط من الخارج والداخل.

Remove 
 any remaining dirts by a soft brush.

Clean the filter casing 
 by a no-fluff cloth like a leather cloth.

Reinstall the 
 cleaned screen basket, the spring of the screen must be about 30 - 40 mm
above the casing flange.

Check the tide seal 
 (replace it if it is required).

Tight the screws of the 
 filter chamber.

Do up venting screw to 
 deaerate the strainer.

Return the fuel gas filter 
 in the service again.
